generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, reflection is something you practise across the School of Sport and beyond. Every placement, practical report, coaching session, group project and piece of feedback is a chance to run the cycle: work through the experience, reflect on it with real depth, and act on what you find. It is also what research, coaching and clinical practice in sport expect, and reflecting deliberately now is what the advanced tier of this pathway develops into a full professional practice.
